description: Land Acquisition - Gunadaha, Thumpane D/S Division, Kandy District	- Mawathagama, Anamaduwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Amendment to the Ex.Gaz.No. 2061/40 at 08.03.2018
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purposes, including lot numbers, land names, extents, boundaries, and claimant information. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
